entries.quote: You have power over your mind - not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength. The soul becomes dyed with the color of its thoughts.
entries.author: Marcus Aurelius

entries.text: Felt a heavy ache of nostalgia today—remembering past summers by the sea. Embraced the quiet sorrow as part of the mind's tapestry.
entries.quote: What I need is not advice, nor consolation, nor a drug. I need the simple, quiet company of someone who knows what it is to sit with sorrow.
entries.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky

entries.quote: Nothing is more serene than a soul that has arrived at its own center, watching the turbulent tides of the world from a high, quiet cliff.
entries.author: Marcus Aurelius

slides.prose: The month of June opened in quiet contemplation, like slow footsteps echoing on smooth travertine stone. You sat within the warm evening breeze, feeling the gentle passage of twilight.
By mid-month, a sweet ache of memory arose—a longing for distant horizons. You embraced this warm nostalgia as a sanctuary of yesteryears coloring present steps.
As June drew to its steady close, you found a calm, centered peace—ataraxia. The storms settled into a restorative sigh carved on the columns of your mind's temple.
